gloss: the following week; the next week

definitions.gloss: the following week; the next week
definitions.explanation: the following week; the next week

examples.japanese: {翌週|よくしゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦もう{一度|いちど}→もう一度：02976_mouichido⟧⟦{会|あ}う→会う：00482_au⟧ことにした。
examples.english: We decided to meet once more the following week.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{翌週|よくしゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{月曜日|げつようび}→月曜日：00624_getsuyoubi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{延期|えんき}→延期：01888_enki⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The meeting was postponed to Monday of the following week.

examples.english: The exams ended, and spring break started from the following week.

notes:
A time expression referring to the week after a given reference point. Unlike ⟦{来週|らいしゅう}→来週：00746_raishuu⟧ (next week), which is relative to the present moment, {翌週|よくしゅう} is used in narrative or written contexts to refer to the week after a past event. Part of the ⟦{翌|よく}→翌〜：03970_yoku⟧ series of time words.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {翌週|よくしゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{月曜日|げつようび}→月曜日：00624_getsuyoubi⟧: the Monday of the following week
- {翌週|よくしゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: enter the following week

RELATED WORDS:

- ⟦{翌月|よくげつ}→翌月：21206_yokugetsu⟧: the following month
- ⟦{翌年|よくねん}→翌年：23355_yokunen⟧: the following year
